pending-clause.answer: This rule does rest on §2002:15.1: it admits reference modification only of alphanumeric, boolean or national functions. 2002 15.1 has the same six types (alphanumeric, boolean, national, numeric, integer, index) as §2023:15.2, each of the same class and category; 2002 adds only that the size is fixed by each function definition, which 2023 leaves to the definition too. So the governed set is the same. Confirming probe at --std 2002: refmod of BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER and NATIONAL-OF accepted and right (BOOL=OK, NAT=BC), alongside the reader's alphanumeric-accept and numeric-refuse cases.
